notes.title: Gverse Alpha Update 0.0.3
notes.notes:
Dear Gverse Players, we are happy to announce the new update!

Major update of the game's first released early access. Included in the update:


• The portal area has been adjusted and the portal to the Old world has been updated.
• The “Safe zone” area in the old world has been updated and recreated.
• Added “Ingot” production to ores mined from mines. (Gold and Bronze can be produced)
• Added Weapon production from Gold and Bronze. You will be able to craft these weapons with Blacksmiths and items dropped from creatures.
• Items dropped from 1-7 Medusa creatures and Creatures' health bars have been updated.
• Items dropped from 8-13 Minotaur creatures and the Creatures' health bars have been updated.
• “Lumber, Blacksmith and Painter” stations that you can place on your own land and inside your house have been added. (Stations can drop from creatures.)
• Added new non-upgradeable “Crystal Swords”. These swords have a chance to drop from creatures.
• The skills of the Sword class have been updated. (2 new skills added)
• The skills of the Archer class have been renewed. (2 new skills added)
• BOSS has been added to the Mutant Forest in the old world. (You can get the boss quest from Uncle Emin NPC.)
• Extra missions that you can find while browsing the game have been added.
• Camera zoom reduced to zero. (You can play in FPS mode.)


Your feedback for the progress of the game is valuable to us. If you have a problem or idea, mention it in the community. The game will continue to be updated.

If you're ready to dive into a new gaming experience, head over to Steam and check out Gverse today!
